name: rest-api-order
description: REST API 設計・実装ガイドのサンプルリポジトリ

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint
scripts.docs:build: npm run bundle && redocly build-docs dist/openapi.yaml --output dist/docs/index.html
scripts.mock: npm run bundle && prism mock dist/openapi.yaml --port 3904
scripts.mock:dynamic: npm run bundle && prism mock dist/openapi.yaml --port 3905 --dynamic
